title: Maternal health check-in
description: Review bleeding, dizziness, and blood pressure concerns during pregnancy follow-up visits.
safetyNote: Urgent symptoms should be escalated to a qualified clinician using local referral pathways.

title: Newborn danger signs
description: Look for fever, poor feeding, irregular breathing, jaundice, lethargy, or weak cry during newborn visits.
safetyNote: Any severe newborn warning sign should trigger urgent referral and clinician review.

title: Emergency referral pathway
description: Use the approved referral steps for severe bleeding, breathing difficulty, unconsciousness, or seizure concerns.
safetyNote: This is a training example only; follow local emergency protocols and approved referral plans.

title: Household follow-up routine
description: Repeat reminders, ask about recent symptoms, and record completion status after each scheduled visit.
safetyNote: Do not record personal identifiers or medical histories in this demo environment.

title: Hygiene and general health education
description: Share safe water, handwashing, waste disposal, and basic infection-prevention habits with households.
safetyNote: This content is general education only and should not replace local public health guidance.

title: Safe data recording
description: Use synthetic IDs, keep notes brief, and avoid personal identifiers in demo records.
safetyNote: Do not store or upload real medical histories in local browser demos.

title: Offline workflows
description: Document the visit, save locally, and only sync when a supported process and approval system are available.
safetyNote: Browser localStorage is not secure patient storage or a production backend.
